title: Integer combinations of integer multiplicity currents, with mass bound (Simon Ch. 6, 3.2(1))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, T₁, T₂, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U), p₁, p₂ ∈ ℤ, and let R₁ = (M₁, θ₁, ξ₁), R₂ = (M₂, θ₂, ξ₂) be integer multiplicity triples (IMRep) in U representing T₁ and T₂. If S(ω) = p₁T₁(ω) + p₂T₂(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U), then S is represented by an integer multiplicity triple R in U whose measure satisfies μ_R ≤ |p₁|μ_{R₁} + |p₂|μ_{R₂} (as measures). This is Simon Ch. 6, Remark 3.2(1), with a mass bound.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T₁ T₂ S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R₁ R₂ : IMRep U n) (p₁ p₂ : ℤ), IsOpen U → R₁.Represents T₁ → R₂.Represents T₂ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, S ω = (p₁ : ℝ) * T₁ ω + (p₂ : ℝ) * T₂ ω) → ∃ R : IMRep U n, R.Represents S ∧ R.measure ≤ (p₁.natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) • R₁.measure + (p₂.natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) • R₂.measure
